Ember.js.description: Ember.js is a comprehensive JavaScript framework that simplifies the development of modern web applications by providing a powerful CLI, a built-in router, and a fast rendering engine.

Express.description: Express is a web application framework for Node.js, released as free and open-source software under the MIT License. It is designed for building web applications and APIs.

Eleventy.description: Eleventy (11ty) a simpler static site generator.

Elasticsearch.description: Elasticsearch is a search engine based on the Lucene library. It provides a distributed, multitenant-capable full-text search engine with an HTTP web interface and schema-free JSON documents.
